//: GO-LIVE CHECKLIST for the API and the media worker (they share these settings). Not used on your machine: setup reads user-secrets.template.json. Every <GO-LIVE ...> value must be replaced before launch. SECRET values go in Key Vault; the rest are container settings (Terraform). Nested keys become environment variables with __, e.g. Email__SendGrid__ApiKey. Values without <...> are what live should use.

ConnectionStrings.AppDatabase: <GO-LIVE: Azure SQL with the app's managed identity, e.g. Server=tcp:<server>.database.windows.net,1433;Database=badjockeys;Authentication=Active Directory Managed Identity;Encrypt=True>

Authentication.Authority: <GO-LIVE: the identity server's address, e.g. https://auth.badjockeys.com>

AllowedOrigins: <GO-LIVE: the web app's address, e.g. https://badjockeys.com>

ApiDocs.//: Swagger UI and the OpenAPI file. Off in live unless the API reference should be public.

Email.//: Notification and report emails. Provider defaults to Log, which sends NOTHING: live must say SendGrid.
Email.FromAddress: <GO-LIVE: e.g. no-reply@badjockeys.com, on a domain verified in SendGrid>
Email.LogoUrl: <GO-LIVE: a PNG logo for email headers, e.g. https://badjockeys.com/email-logo.png>

SendGrid.ApiKey: <GO-LIVE SECRET: SendGrid API key with the Mail Send permission only>

SMS.//: Texts (mobile number verification, UI overhaul step 6). Provider defaults to Log, which sends NOTHING: live must say Twilio. Use an API key rather than the auth token, and a Messaging Service rather than one number.

Twilio.MessagingServiceSid: <GO-LIVE: Messaging Service SID, MG... (UK alphanumeric sender BADJOCKEYS needs registering)>

Storage.//: Cloudflare R2 (S3Mock on your machine). The originals bucket needs CORS PUT from the web app's address and a 90-day deletion rule; the sensitive bucket needs neither and must stay private.
Storage.AccessKeyId: <GO-LIVE SECRET: R2 API token access key, Object Read & Write on the live buckets only>
Storage.PublicBaseUrl: <GO-LIVE: the public bucket's custom domain behind Cloudflare, e.g. https://media.badjockeys.com/>

Processing.//: Media worker only. Paths inside the worker's container image.

Redaction.//: Media worker only. Without the models every upload goes to review. ReviewEverything=true at launch (decision 19 Oct): every upload is checked by a moderator until blurring has a track record.
Redaction.FaceModelPath: <GO-LIVE: path in the worker image, e.g. /opt/bjk/models/face_detection_yunet_2023mar.onnx>
Redaction.PlateModelPath: <GO-LIVE: path in the worker image, e.g. /opt/bjk/models/license_plate_detection_lpd_yunet_2023mar.onnx>

SensitiveDetection.//: Media worker only. Off until a gore/injury classifier has been chosen and tested; once on, a missing model sends every upload to review.
SensitiveDetection.ModelPath: <GO-LIVE (when enabled): path to the chosen classifier, e.g. /opt/bjk/models/graphic-content.onnx>

Captcha.//: Cloudflare Turnstile on the public report form. The local value is Cloudflare's always-pass test key.
Captcha.TurnstileSecretKey: <GO-LIVE SECRET: the Turnstile widget's secret key (its site key goes in the web app's TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY)>

Screening.//: Keywords (built-in list) works with no supplier. Http adds a classifier service (e.g. Detoxify in a sidecar).
Screening.Endpoint: <GO-LIVE (only if Provider is Http): the classifier's address, e.g. http://localhost:8000/score>

Reels.ViewerKeySecret: <GO-LIVE SECRET: a long random string (openssl rand -base64 48); hashes logged-out viewers' ids and IP addresses>

Plans.//: Billing (Stripe) isn't built yet. Until the identity server issues the plan claim, Overrides gives chosen accounts a plan. Live: empty, then remove once billing exists.

Notifications.AppUrl: <GO-LIVE: the web app's address, for links in emails, e.g. https://badjockeys.com>

Posts.//: ReportsInbox and AppUrl arrive with bjk-modules #30 (report emails). The inbox must exist before launch.
Posts.AppUrl: <GO-LIVE: the web app's address, e.g. https://badjockeys.com>
